마지막 표행 — New Flow Music instrumental soundtrack · 1.11.0

새벽의 짐끈 / 청하로 가는 길 / 돌아온 표국

Three new original instrumentals composed for Last Delivery on 2026-11-05
with Google Flow Music, model Lyria 3.5, through the official web composer
using browser MCP. Instrumental mode was enabled and length was set to 3:00.
No existing recording was supplied, remixed or used as a reference.
The existing wuxia recordings reserved for the Muhon Bidong remake were
left intact and are excluded by source identifier and file-hash comparison.

Original downloads and exact requests are retained in:
source_assets/audio/flow-music-2026-11-05/
Preparation: scripts/prepare-flow-bgm.py
Delivered file hashes, duration, processing and provenance: manifest.json
Full-duration signal review and reserved-source records: content-review.json

The game copies preserve the complete original chronological performance,
with DC removal, consistent gain, short endpoint fades and AAC-LC encoding.
No repeated padding, internal loop, tempo change or scene-based switching.
Each song plays to its natural file ending in a shuffled playlist.
Signal inspection and technical playback checks are not an auditory review.

New composition pages:
https://www.flowmusic.app/song/43014563-9d31-4e81-aeb0-d2f8488b93d5
https://www.flowmusic.app/song/f7dcdbce-4c56-4aeb-9c11-b3ff07261568
https://www.flowmusic.app/song/17aecc02-63f3-461c-b602-a208c5addd52

SFX remain the original real-time Web Audio synthesis in dist/audio.mjs.
Previous YuE2 sources and release records are preserved locally for history.
